purpose: Every significant engineering claim about SOKONI, with the evidence behind it. State is DERIVED from sources by scripts/evidence-ledger.js — never declared here. A claim cannot promote itself.

stateRules.ASSUMED: no source of any kind. A belief.
stateRules.OBSERVED: one source. Usually the repository. Enough to act on, not enough to certify.
stateRules.VERIFIED: at least one EXECUTED source — a test run or a runtime observation. Reading code is not verification.
stateRules.CERTIFIED: two or more INDEPENDENT source types agree. Repository plus a passing test is not independence if the test only reads the same file.
stateRules.REJECTED: a contradicting source outweighs the supporting ones.

claims.claim: Products are indexed to the same Algolia index the live search reads.
claims.note: Both sources inspect the same source files. The test proves the strings match; neither proves a document reaches the index. Runtime confirmation requires a live indexing observation.

claims.claim: An uploaded product is discoverable in production search.

contradictions.ref: existing products carry no `status`; backfill never run
the index-name fix is committed but unpushed (RULE-010)

claims.note: The fix exists. The outcome does not. This is the claim that matters commercially and it is currently REJECTED.

claims.claim: Authorisation guards accept a legitimate administrator.

contradictions.ref: no administrator exists in production to test against

claims.note: The logic is proven correct in isolation. It has never admitted a real administrator, because there is no real administrator.

claims.claim: A super administrator can be provisioned.

sources.ref: 8f38864 — UID allowlist replaces the email gate

contradictions.ref: doctor.js reports BOOTSTRAP READINESS: NOT READY — Admin SDK credentials revoked

claims.note: Blocked on credentials, not on code.

claims.claim: A customer can pay for an order with M-PESA.

contradictions.ref: IntaSend returned 'Invalid api token' against a live key on the live host

claims.note: No M-PESA transaction has ever completed end to end. For a marketplace this is the load-bearing claim, and it has zero supporting evidence.

claims.claim: The Banking Hub bottom navigation is reachable on a phone.

sources.ref: measured y=608 on a 664px viewport after scrolling, WebKit iPhone 13 (was y=1157)

claims.note: Three independent source types, one of them a direct measurement. This is what CERTIFIED should look like.

claims.claim: Every Banking Hub tile performs a visible action.

sources.ref: 17/17 tabs change active state and show exactly one matching pane; was 0 of 8

claims.note: Measured before/after DOM state, not merely 'the handler did not throw' — which is what the first probe measured and got wrong.

claims.claim: POS provisioning completes for a real merchant.
claims.note: Diagnostics and a preflight now exist, but they are instruments, not outcomes. Nothing has been pointed at a real account.

claims.claim: The seller dashboard shows the merchant's real products.

sources.ref: sokoni-seller-products.js hydrates the cache from the canonical collection

contradictions.ref: the KASS VAPES product count has never been observed

claims.note: The read path is fixed and tested. Whether three vapes appear on the owner's screen is unobserved.

claims.claim: Mobile layouts have no horizontal overflow and no tap target under 40px.

sources.ref: measured on iPhone SE / 13 / 14 Pro Max across banking, healthcare, services

claims.note: Scoped to the pages measured. Says nothing about the other 300+.

claims.claim: The platform is ready to launch.

contradictions.ref: RULE-010: 213 commits ahead of origin; production runs the unrepaired code

claims.note: Recorded so the ledger holds the uncomfortable claim as well as the flattering ones.

claims.claim: Cloud Functions are deployed and serving.

contradictions.ref: 112 functions exported in index.js are absent from the deployed set

claims.note: Deployed and CURRENT are different claims. The deployed code predates every fix from this cycle.

claims.claim: Search, payments and merchant activation are protected against regression.
claims.note: Tests run against the repository, not against production. They prevent a regression being written; they do not prove the feature works.
No accessibility audit has ever been run. This is the honest shape of an UNKNOWN — no evidence for it and none against it.

claims.claim: The platform can serve a million users.
claims.note: No load test at any scale has ever been run. Any performance number quoted anywhere in this project is an estimate.
